## Summary

The full 2026-05-01 [[stripe|Stripe]] Terminal guide explains how to request a reusable payment method as part of an in-person payment. It covers Server-driven, JavaScript, iOS, Android and React Native variants, including customer consent, `generated_card` retrieval and conditional fallback. The 2026-11-07 capture is a navigation index for those five variants. The implementation guidance below comes from the May capture.

## Key Takeaways

- **One-flow save** — Create the `card_present` PaymentIntent with `setup_future_usage` to request a `generated_card`. Use `on_session` for reuse only with the customer present and `off_session` otherwise.
- **Initial payment and follow-up charges** — The in-person payment is card-present. Subsequent `generated_card` charges are card-not-present and lack card-present liability-shift and pricing benefits.
- **Consent and `allow_redisplay`** — After the customer consents to saving, pass `always` or `limited` at collection or processing. The guide dates the requirement to March 31, 2025 for non-React Native integrations and September 30, 2025 for React Native.
- **`generated_card` retrieval** — A successful payment with a future-use-capable method returns a PaymentIntent in `requires_capture` or `succeeded`. Expand `latest_charge` and check `payment_method_details.card_present.generated_card` for the distinct reusable `card` PaymentMethod. The method attaches automatically if the customer ID was supplied at creation. Otherwise, attach it separately.
- **Availability** — Verify that `generated_card` is present. Some digital-wallet and single-branded Interac, eftpos or girocard payments might produce none.
- **Saved mobile wallets** — The May guide restricts them to off-session reuse. Their `generated_card` has `allow_redisplay=limited`. Pass `off_session=true` when confirming the later PaymentIntent. When the customer is present, the guide directs you to re-prompt with the Apple Pay or Google Pay integration.

## Supported Card Networks

Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, co-branded eftpos, co-branded Interac, co-branded girocard.

## When generated_card Is Absent (Fallback)

If a reusable payment method is required, the May guide offers two options.

- Ask the customer to save a different method via the [save directly (SetupIntent) flow](https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/saving-payment-details/save-directly.md).
- Refund the in-person payment, indicate the transaction failed, and ask the customer to use a different method.

## SDK Notes

| SDK | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| Server-driven | The May guide specifies `Stripe-Version: 2024-09-30.acacia` for this feature. Use `process_payment_intent`, or use Preview `collect_payment_method` to access card brand or funding before separately calling `confirm_payment_intent`. |
| JavaScript | `collectPaymentMethod` with `config_override: { allow_redisplay }` |
| iOS | `collectPaymentMethod` — requires iOS SDK v4.3.0+ |
| Android | `collectPaymentMethod` — requires Android SDK v4.0.0+ |
| React Native | `collectPaymentMethod` with `allowRedisplay` |

## Customer/Account Creation

The May guide recommends `stripe.v2.core.accounts.create()` with `configuration.customer` for most use cases. It describes Accounts v2 as generally available for Connect users and in public preview for other Stripe users, with a preview API version required for preview participants.

Customers v1: `stripe.customers.create()` — returns a `Customer` object with an `id` to store for later.

terminal-features-saving-payment-details.Q1: The 2026-11-07 capture at https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/saving-payment-details/save-after-payment says the merchant can accept an in-person payment and save payment details for later customer-absent use and directs integrators to five implementations (new raw lines 1-17). The index itself supplies no consent terms, generated-card state transition, object assignment or API/SDK prerequisite. The 2026-05-01 details retained by source-stripe-terminal-save-after-payment document a customer represented by a Customer or customer-configured Account, the PaymentIntent setup_future_usage distinction, and passing consent-appropriate allow_redisplay after customer consent at processing or collection (old raw lines 29-31, old raw lines 69-73 and old raw lines 94-102). The PaymentIntent following a successful future-use-capable payment is requires_capture or succeeded, and the reusable card is retrieved from the expanded latest charge and automatically attached if the Customer ID was provided at creation (old raw lines 153-157). The former summary overstated absence from wallets. The revised summary says some digital-wallet payments might not generate a card and preserves the guide’s saved-wallet off-session use with limited redisplay (old raw lines 153-166).
terminal-features-saving-payment-details.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/saving-payment-details/save-after-payment, the 2026-11-07 change from “is not” to “isn't” is presentational (old raw line 6 and new raw line 7), and the explicit Server-driven, JavaScript, iOS, Android and React Native links are navigation (new raw lines 9-17). The 2026-05-01 full text and source-stripe-terminal-save-after-payment remain the historical implementation route, with the 2026-11-07 index as a dated raw_reference and the reciprocal stripe-terminal-save-payment-details concept link, Stripe index route and save-directly companion retained. No substantive behavior change follows from the missing bodies. Preserve the 2026-05-01 Accounts v2 GA/preview scope (old raw lines 8-14), mandatory allow_redisplay dates of March 31, 2025 for non-React Native and September 30, 2025 for React Native (old raw line 23), the historical Server-driven 2024-09-30.acacia header and collect_payment_method Preview with separate confirmation (old raw lines 94-102 and old raw lines 136-138), and iOS/Android SDK minimums of 4.3.0+/4.0.0+ (old raw lines 371-377 and old raw lines 522-528). The revised summary and proposed concept corrections distinguish potentially missing generated cards from off-session-only saved wallet reuse (old raw lines 153-166) and limit the lost liability-shift/pricing benefits to card-present ones (old raw lines 16-23).

concept_suggestions.anchor: Stripe Terminal can collect card-present payment methods and save them for future online reuse. Because card-present PaymentMethods can't be saved directly, Stripe creates a `generated_card` PaymentMethod representing the same card — usable for online charges, subscriptions, and off-session payments.
concept_suggestions.proposed_markdown: Stripe Terminal can collect payment details in person for future online reuse. Stripe can generate a separate reusable `generated_card` PaymentMethod for the same card, subject to the payment method and flow. Reuse depends on the payment method and the customer's consent.
